purpose: Hash-lockable reference envelope for testing whether the amphora-molecule-generator deterministic-grammar hardener universe covers the STOICHIOMETRIC design axis (AHEW / amine value / mix-ratio phr) that governs two-part marine epoxy-amine formulation. Anchors are (a) commercial amidoamine/polyamide hardener AHEW values already shipped as facts in amphora-ingredient-library, and (b) definitional known-answer amines whose active-N-H counts are hand-checkable from structure.
scope: marine anti-corrosion two-part epoxy-amine (DGEBA + amine hardener)

instrument_definitions.ahew_g_per_eq: AHEW = M / n_activeH, where n_activeH is the count of hydrogens bonded to epoxy-reactive (non-amide, non-aromatic-ring) nitrogen. Lee & Neville 1967, Handbook of Epoxy Resins, McGraw-Hill (LCCN 66-23992).
instrument_definitions.amine_value_mgKOH_per_g: AV = 56105.6 * n_basicN / M (mg KOH per g). ASTM D2074 total amine value; 56105.6 mg/mol = molar mass of KOH x 1000.
instrument_definitions.mix_ratio_phr: phr = 100 * AHEW / EEW at 1:1 epoxide:amine-hydrogen stoichiometry (parts hardener per hundred parts resin by mass).
instrument_definitions.identity_band: AHEW * AV = 56105.6 * n_basicN / n_activeH, hence AHEW*AV in [28052.8, 56105.6] for any amine whose nitrogens are primary (2H) through secondary (1H). All-primary amines sit exactly on the 28052.8 floor.

commercial_anchors.note: Numeric AHEW values re-read from amphora-ingredient-library/reference/mvp20/data/facts.json entries already shipped in this repository. No new external data was acquired or redistributed; these are design-envelope anchor scalars only.

entries.note: US 120 vs EMEA 110 regional conflict flagged upstream; US value used

entries.marine_qualification: supplier guide marks MIL-P-24441 / Ships approved

known_answer_amines.note: Definitional known-answer set. expected_active_nh is hand-checkable from the structure; AHEW is then the exact definitional quotient M/n_activeH with M re-derived by RDKit from IUPAC 2021 standard atomic weights. These test the INSTRUMENT, not any commercial product claim.

fail_closed_decoys.note: Non-hardener or non-active-hydrogen structures that the AHEW instrument MUST reject (n_activeH = 0 => AHEW undefined) or classify as non-difunctional.

entries.name: benzamide (amide N-H, not epoxy-reactive at ambient)

dgeba_reference.eew_monomeric_provenance: amphora-molecule-property DGEBA oligomer EEW series receipt, EEW(n) = 170.21 + 142.18n at n=0
dgeba_reference.eew_technical_note: typical technical liquid DGEBA EEW used only as a second phr reference point

adduct_closure_operator.definition: k mol diamine + 1 mol DGEBA -> one amine-terminated adduct; the two DGEBA epoxide groups each consume one active N-H. M_adduct = k*M_amine + M_DGEBA; n_activeH_adduct = k*n_activeH_amine - 2; AHEW_adduct = M_adduct / n_activeH_adduct.
adduct_closure_operator.citation: Lee & Neville 1967, Handbook of Epoxy Resins, McGraw-Hill (amine-epoxy adduct curing agents); Ellis (ed.) 1993, Chemistry and Technology of Epoxy Resins, Blackie/Chapman & Hall, ISBN 978-0-7514-0095-4.
adduct_closure_operator.status: ANALYTIC_PROJECTION_ONLY -- this operator is NOT implemented as a generator production rule; it is evaluated here to quantify what capability would be required to close the measured envelope gap.

rights_posture.commercial_anchor_basis: numeric scalars already shipped in amphora-ingredient-library facts.json (TDS / SUPPLIER_GUIDE grade), used as design-envelope anchors
rights_posture.known_answer_basis: definitional identity AHEW = M/n_activeH; molar masses re-derived by RDKit from IUPAC 2021 standard atomic weights
